transcript: Consultant: What are you trying to build? Client: A membership directory with member profiles and category pages. We need our branding and a simple inquiry form. Consultant: We will check which pieces are native before estimating custom work.

Client: We want a local business directory with categories, city filters, member profiles, and a monthly export. Consultant: Is the export CSV, PDF, or email? Client: We have not decided. Mark reporting as discovery until the format and delivery are confirmed.

Client: We want profiles, categories, and search. Consultant: We will verify native capabilities. Follow-up: also add a paid featured listing and a monthly emailed report. These need documentation checks and clarified acceptance criteria before final scope.
